name: Ah! My Goddess
description: Keiichi Morisato is looking forward to university life. But in reality, he has no luck in anything, and he has trouble with clubs, love, etc. The truth is that he has an unlucky star above his head. One day, Keiichi is stuck watching the dorm while his senpai are away, and has a mountain of chores to do to boot. But Keiichi is a good-natured person, and is set about doing his duties. As he is about to finish his final chore, he makes a phone call to his senpai. But the words that came through the receiver are, "Goddess Help Line." Shortly afterwards, a beautiful goddess named Belldandy appears in front of him from the mirror of his room...

videos.title: Ah! An Exchange Diary with the Goddess?
videos.overview: Recap of the first season.

videos.title: Ah! Urd's Little Romance
videos.overview: The goddesses are working overtime to restore the damage done by the Lord of Terror, but in order to conserve energy, Urd automatically reverts to her younger form. The more energy she uses, the younger she becomes. While waiting for Yggdrasil to come back online, she is thrust into an unlikely situation with a boy she meets at a playground. Meanwhile, Belldandy and Keiichi work on a cure for Urd's "condition."

videos.title: Ah! Is My Heart Pounding Because I'm a Grownup?
videos.overview: Yggdrasil's downtime causes Skuld to become a grown woman. She has until sundown, when Yggdrasil is restored, to experience life as an adult. After escaping an uncomfortable situation with Toshiyuki Aoshima, Skuld explores her newly grown feelings for Keiichi, and asks him to go out with her the rest of the day.

videos.title: Ah! Everyone Has a Destiny!
videos.overview: Keiichi, the goddesses, and the motor club gang visit a family friend's house, and meet a woman named Chieko Honda, but she is a contemporary of Keiichi's grandfather, and had passed away. Could she be a ghost? The goddesses apparently think so, and Keiichi must figure out the reason she's still around and the loose ends she's trying to have resolved.

videos.title: Ah! The Song of Love That Shakes the Heart!
videos.overview: Peorth realizes that Keiichi has not voiced his affections for Belldandy before.

videos.title: Ah! The One-Winged Angel Descends!
videos.overview: A dark force causes several angels in Heaven to collapse. Lind, the legendary Valkyrie, arrives on Earth and declares a state of emergency: The Angel Eater has escaped!

videos.title: Ah! Two of Us, Together in Joy!
videos.overview: Lind, Keiichi, and the Goddesses continue their struggle against Hild and the Angel Eater.

videos.title: Ah! Are You a Goddess?
videos.overview: The day begins with a routine set of exercise with the Auto Club for Keiichi. Afterwards he goes to catch a little more sleep, and ends up nearly being late for school. When he goes to get his bike, it won't start, so he has to run to school.

videos.title: Ah! People Who Believe Are Saved?
videos.overview: Keiichi makes his wish that Belldandy will stay with him forever, and it becomes true! And it can't be undone; the wish has been registered with the system. Keiichi ponders what to do now, but his senpais Tamiya and Otaki arrive and find that he's broken the rules about having girls in the all-guys dorm. What will happen to Keiichi and Belldandy now?

videos.title: Ah! Apprenticeship, My Home and a Goddess
videos.overview: Keiichi and Belldandy search for a place to live, trying out real estate apartment listings, his friends' apartments, and eventually a fairly worn down temple where a monk lets them in.

videos.title: Ah! The Queen and the Goddess
videos.overview: Keiichi takes Belldandy to his school, and all the classmates are impressed by the new girl. Sayoko, the popular girl on campus, meets Belldandy and tries to figure out where she came from.

videos.title: Ah! Under One Roof
videos.overview: Keiichi left his books and papers at home, so Belldandy goes back to get it. As Keiichi is left alone at school, Sayoko challenges him to stop acting like he's in elementary school with that relationship. Keiichi struggles on what to say to Belldandy. He sets up a romantic mood at home with candles and all. Will that do the trick? Or will it be written off as another coincidence?

videos.title: Ah! Unexpectedly Finding Something Blessed?
videos.overview: A young woman shows up at the temple where Keiichi is staying. It turns out to be Keiichi's sister Megumi, who is in town looking for apartment housing. Keiichi and Belldandy help Megumi find a place, but it has a dark secret.

videos.title: Ah! The Place to Express Your Feelings
videos.overview: Belldandy learns about Valentine's day in Japan. Sayoko tries to set Belldandy up with the campus playboy Toshiyuki Aoshima. This could be trouble!

videos.title: Ah! Taking an Examination of Love, Starting with a Deviation Value of 30
videos.overview: Keiichi gets a video from a store, but when he plays it, a mysterious woman shows on the screen. The woman is Urd, who is Belldandy's older sister. Urd tries to move Keiichi's romantic intentions forward by slipping him a controlling love potion.

videos.title: Ah! The Secret of the Queen and the Goddess
videos.overview: Belldandy wins the Miss NIT contest and becomes Campus Queen. Sayoko and Toshiyuki try to uncover Belldandy's identity by setting up revealing situations where Belldandy would have to use her magic, but with big sister Urd watching, that isn't so easily done.

videos.title: Ah! Can the Motor Club Win?
videos.overview: The Nekomi Motor Club is recruiting new members, but now there's a new rival club called Four Wheels that was started by Toshiyuki. The motor clubs have a challenge race over who gets to keep their club around.

videos.title: Ah! A Devil Comes and Bestows Misfortune?
videos.overview: Tamiya and Otaki buy a strange Demons CD from a store. Not only is the music strange, but a spirit shoots out of the CD and asks what wish they want.

videos.title: Ah! Put the Goddess and Queen on a Balance?
videos.overview: Marller offers Sayoko a plan to get Belldandy out of the way. Sayoko tricks Urd and steals the Demons CD. Marller casts a spell to tip Keiichi's heart balance so that Keiichi becomes fixated on Sayoko. After Belldandy goes home feeling strange, Sayoko is alone with Keiichi. This is her big chance, but what are all these suggestions Keiichi has?

videos.title: Ah! Who Does Big Sister Belong To?
videos.overview: When Heaven's main computer, Yggdrassil, crashes due to an infestation of "bugs," a lone Goddess determines that she needs the help of her big sister... Belldandy!

videos.title: Ah! A Teaching Practice Called Showdown?
videos.overview: Skuld's been spending a lot of time with Belldandy, but Belldandy still wants to go to school with Keiichi. Skuld decides to take apart Keiichi's bike, but ends up upgrading it. Megumi notices the upgrades and starts to critique it. This upsets Skuld, who issues Megumi a mechanic's challenge. At the suggestion of Keiichi's senpai, Skuld and Megumi enter a robot battle contest to settle their conflicts.

videos.title: Ah! Captivated by a Goddess?
videos.overview: Skuld reveals her latest invention: Banpei RX. Banpei is a robot designed to protect Belldandy, which he does easily as Marller shows up for an attack. But that also means protecting her from Keiichi and Urd and draining tons of power from the house. Can Skuld teach Banpei to play nice? And what will they do when Marller launches another attack?

videos.title: Ah! Catastrophe Comes with Rise of an Auspicious Sign?
videos.overview: Marller's attacks on the goddesses keep failing so she goes for a new target: Megumi! She takes over Megumi's body, and solicits the help of Senbee, the God of Poverty and generally bad luck spirit.

videos.title: Ah! What Are Talent and Hard Work?
videos.overview: Club member Sora is entered into an all-girls racing event. Belldandy and the gang help her overcome her fears of driving and of messing up everything.

videos.title: Ah! Confess Your Love Under the Moon?
videos.overview: Megumi gives Keiichi some tickets to a beach resort. Keiichi and Belldandy go, but the sisters tag along as well. Urd tells Keiichi there's an island spot where if he confesses it will be true love. Keiichi tries to take Belldandy to that remote island location, but Skuld has other plans.

videos.title: Ah! Don't Gaze at Me with Those Eyes?
videos.overview: Urd makes a love candy for Keiichi, but Skuld suspects something and slips in some additional ingredients. Belldandy consumes it, and she becomes very romantically bold in all her actions and with Keiichi too!

videos.title: Ah! Save the Goddess, If You're a Man?!
videos.overview: Urd and Skuld leave to do some work back at heaven. Skuld has Keiichi eat some flan which transforms Keiichi into a woman. Now he'll keep his hands off Belldandy, right?

videos.title: Ah! The One I Yearn for Is a White-Winged Angel!
videos.overview: Skuld admires Belldandy's angel and wants to have one as well. Skuld tries training her skills with inventions. Then something outside threatens the girls and it's up to Urd to summon her angel, but it's revealed that Urd can't because she told her angel earlier to never come out ever again. What will the goddesses do?

videos.title: Ah! A Devil's Whisper, Along with a Pot?
videos.overview: Marller retrieves a demonic urn from a cave. Urd's goddess license had been suspended, which motivates her to look for a regular job. But when things go bad there she accepts her demonic heritage and transforms into the Lord of Terror! Big trouble for Keiichi and the gals!

videos.title: Ah! The Savior of the World Arrives with the Sound of the Flute?
videos.overview: The Yggdrasil system is in chaos from all the attacks from the Lord of Terror. Urd starts releasing the Ultimate Destruction Program which will not only destroy the current world but allow the demons to rule it. Belldandy decides to release her sealed power and confront Urd. God gives Skuld a Midgard Flute as a last-chance vaccine to stop the Lord of Terror. Will those efforts be enough?

videos.title: Ah! I'm Always with You
videos.overview: It's the final showdown where the goddesses, Belldandy and Skuld, battle against the Lord of Terror, who has now possessed Midgard! With the whole world at stake, what can Keiichi do to help?

videos.title: Ah! I Wish... Once More!
videos.overview: After the fiasco involving the Lord of Terror, the Goddess Technical Helpline is missing important information including Keiichi Morisato's wish.

videos.title: Ah! The Beleaguered Queen of Vengeance!
videos.overview: With Christmas approaching, Sayoko Mishima desires to spend her time with the only man on campus who does not appear to "worship" her, that being Keiichi.

videos.title: Ah! I Offer These Feelings on Christmas Eve!
videos.overview: While Keiichi and Belldandy are working at the convenience store, the town is covered with the single color of Christmas. Keiichi, remembering that Belldandy has been with him for about a year decides to get her a present.

videos.title: Ah! I Want to Fill the World with Happiness!
videos.overview: Keiichi, Belldandy, and the others attend Sayoko's Christmas party.

videos.title: Ah! Well-Matched Vibes of Love!
videos.overview: Hikozaemon Otaki fixes the scooter of Satoko Yamano who is being harassed by Toshiyuki and falls in love with her.

videos.title: Ah! Is That Jealouy?!
videos.overview: Keiichi receives his first love letter from an underclassman

videos.title: Ah! I Shall Grant Your Wish!
videos.overview: Keiichi and Belldandy look at photos they have taken recently.

videos.title: Ah! I Want to Be of Use to You!
videos.overview: Ignoring Belldandy's feelings, Urd, Skuld, and Peorth compete to see which of them is most suited to serve Keiichi.

videos.title: Ah! The Goddesses Go Head to Head on a Date!
videos.overview: After reading a romantic comic book, Peorth wishes to go on a date with Keiichi.

videos.title: Ah! I Just Can't Say It!
videos.overview: Peorth continues to vie for Keiichi's affections while feeding him food she prepared.

videos.title: Ah! Grasp Your Dream with Your Own Hands!
videos.overview: Toraichi Tamiya and Otaki suddenly announce to the Auto Club that they have to leave town.

videos.title: Ah! A Goddess's Tears and His Dream!
videos.overview: Troubadour, the plum blossom spirit who once was Urd's lover, appears, urging to reunite with Urd.

videos.title: Ah! Let Those Feelings Awaken
videos.overview: After betting that Urd cannot ride a ride, Skuld is proven wrong, and thus relinquishes her ice cream as her wager.

videos.title: Ah! My Darling Cupid!
videos.overview: Skuld's feelings of affection towards Sentaro awakens her magical powers

videos.title: Ah! I'm Half Goddess, Half Demon?!
videos.overview: Marller surprisingly visits the onsen resort along with Keiichi, Belldandy, Urd, and Skuld.

videos.title: Ah! Shimmer Without Fear of the Darkness!
videos.overview: Belldandy philosophizes what would happen Urd's demon and goddess halves remain split, knowing that would cause Urd to self-destruct.

videos.title: Ah! The Chair of Demonkind Descends!
videos.overview: Even though Urd has reunified her halves, she bares a dissociative identity disorder, as her demon halves suffers memory loss.

videos.title: Ah! Do Demons Have Any Dignity?!
videos.overview: Hild pays a visit to a reminiscent Marller, who is dissatisfied of working at a convenience store.

videos.title: Ah! The Love of a Goddess Saves the Ninja!
videos.overview: Marller has revived three female rodent ninjas in another attempt to attack Belldandy.

videos.title: Ah! It Doesn't Matter Where, So Long as We're Together!
videos.overview: Everyone seems to show up asking to store items at the temple, creating a bit of a crush. In an effort to make more room, Skuld creates a device to double the storage space in a room.

videos.title: Ah! Would It Be Okay If I Were a Demon?!
videos.overview: After three days, Belldandy returns from heaven but discovers that she has been issued a demon license instead of a goddess license.

videos.title: Ah! The Goddess's Confession!
videos.overview: It is shown that Keiichi and Hild are lovers, confusing the three goddesses that Keiichi may be under demonic control.

language: Japanese, English, French, German, Korean, Tagalog
